studies.title: AMR-SD: Asymmetric Meta-Reflective Self-Distillation for Token-Level Credit Assignment

studies.title: When Are Teacher Tokens Reliable? Position-Weighted On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning

criteria.intervention_exposure: Position-weighted OPSD with clipped forward-KL target.

criteria.results: Position score AUROC 0.83 versus at most 0.57 for local uncertainty; Avg@12 +1.0 and +1.1.
criteria.study_design: Method paper, preprint; abstract read only.
